summary: SLM-CPU-207 verified the exact Qwen3 Q8_0 and Qwen2.5 Q8_0 model artifacts needed for explicit-path warm-session receipt capture, but blocks fresh before/after receipt capture because the current slm-warm-session aggregate emitter always calls the no-bias apply-linear receipt gate with None. Fresh warm-session runs would preserve normal CPU inference behavior but cannot populate the required model-bound descriptor/callsite identity, prompt/generated/text digests, or no-bias apply-linear before/after gate fields.

warm_session_aggregate_callsite.effect: aggregate warm-session receipts cannot receive a real DenseLinearNoBiasApplyLinearBeforeAfterReceiptGate

receipt_emitter_function.effect_when_gate_is_none: before_after_receipts_present=false, descriptor_callsite_identity_preserved=false, prompt/generated/text digest preservation=false, and model/role/tensor fields remain null

capture_decision.capture_attempted_reason: Static source inspection shows the required no-bias apply-linear gate object is not wired into slm-warm-session receipts. Running long Qwen3 and Qwen2.5 before/after sessions now would emit the same disabled placeholder gate and would not satisfy SLM-CPU-207 acceptance.

remaining_blocker.description: Construct and pass a real DenseLinearNoBiasApplyLinearBeforeAfterReceiptGate, or an equivalent receipt-safe boundary object, into the warm-session aggregate for exact Qwen3/Qwen2.5 before/after runs. The object must bind model SHA, quant format, manifest or role identity, tensor name, role/layer/scope/linear, bias_present=false where applicable, selected path/kernel, candidate path/kernel, runtime gate state, prompt/generated/text digests, descriptor/callsite identity, runtime_api=cpu, selected_backend=cpu-rust, and fallback=false while keeping candidate execution disabled.
remaining_blocker.next_safe_step: Add a narrow receipt-emitter wiring slice, then run explicit-path Qwen3 and Qwen2.5 before/after strict warm-session receipts. Do not enable the no-bias candidate or claim allocation/timing improvements.
